displayNetworkMembersCount.description: Output only. Estimated number of members in this user list, on the Google Display Network.

searchNetworkMembersCount.description: Output only. Estimated number of members in this user list in the google.com domain. These are the members available for targeting in Search campaigns.

youtubeMembersCount.description: Output only. Estimated number of members in this user list on YouTube.

SizeInfo.description: Estimated number of members in this user list in different target networks.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the user list global license customer.

licenseType.description: Output only. Product type of client customer which the user list is being licensed to.

clientAccountId.description: Output only. ID of client customer which the user list is being licensed to.

userListDisplayName.description: Output only. Name of the user list being licensed.

clientAccountDisplayName.description: Output only. Name of client customer which the user list is being licensed to.

metrics.description: Output only. Metrics related to this license This field is only populated if the start and end dates are set in the ListUserListGlobalLicenseCustomerInfos call.

userListId.description: Output only. ID of the user list being licensed.

clientAccountType.description: Output only. Product type of client customer which the user list is being licensed to.

historicalPricings.description: Output only. Pricing history of this user list license.

enumDescriptions: Active status - user list is still being licensed.
Inactive status - user list is no longer being licensed.
status.description: Output only. Status of UserListDirectLicense - ENABLED or DISABLED.

UserListGlobalLicenseCustomerInfo.description: Information about a customer of a user list global license. This will automatically be created by the system when a customer purchases a global license.

accountId.description: Required. The identifier of the customer account in the partner's ID space.

accountName.description: Optional. The name of the account.

accountType.description: Optional. The type of the account. Can be used to distinguish between advertiser accounts and business level accounts, for example.

PartnerCustomerAccount.description: Represents a customer account in the partner's system.

Consent.description: [Digital Markets Act (DMA)](//digital-markets-act.ec.europa.eu/index_en) consent settings for the user.

adUserData.description: Optional. Represents if the user consents to ad user data.

adPersonalization.description: Optional. Represents if the user consents to ad personalization.

IngestEventsStatus.description: The status of the events ingestion to the destination.

recordCount.description: The total count of events sent in the upload request. Includes all events in the request, regardless of whether they were successfully ingested or not.

advertiserIdentifierCount.description: Optional. The count of the advertiser's first party data records that have been uploaded to a clean room provider. This does not signify the size of a PAIR user list.

matchRatePercentage.description: Required. This field denotes the percentage of membership match of this user list with the corresponding publisher's first party data. Must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

publisherId.description: Required. Immutable. Identifies the publisher that the Publisher Advertiser Identity Reconciliation user list is reconciled with. This field is provided by the cleanroom provider and is only unique in the scope of that cleanroom. This cannot be used as a global identifier across multiple cleanrooms.

cleanRoomIdentifier.description: Required. Immutable. Identifies a unique advertiser to publisher relationship with one clean room provider or across multiple clean room providers.

publisherName.description: Required. Descriptive name of the publisher to be displayed in the UI for a better targeting experience.

PairIdInfo.description: Additional information when `PAIR_ID` is one of the `upload_key_types`. This feature is only available to data partners.

IngestEventsRequest.description: Request to upload audience members to the provided destinations. Returns an IngestEventsResponse.

events.description: Required. The list of events to send to the specified destinations. At most 2000 Event resources can be sent in a single request.

destinations.description: Required. The list of destinations to send the events to.

consent.description: Optional. Request-level consent to apply to all users in the request. User-level consent overrides request-level consent, and can be specified in each Event.

encryptionInfo.description: Optional. Encryption information for UserData uploads. If not set, it's assumed that uploaded identifying information is hashed but not encrypted. For non `UserData` uploads, this field is ignored.

encoding.description: Optional. Required for UserData uploads. The encoding type of the user identifiers. For hashed user identifiers, this is the encoding type of the hashed string. For encrypted hashed user identifiers, this is the encoding type of the outer encrypted string, but not necessarily the inner hashed string, meaning the inner hashed string could be encoded in a different way than the outer encrypted string. For non `UserData` uploads, this field is ignored.
enumDescriptions: Unspecified Encoding type. Should never be used.

validateOnly.description: Optional. For testing purposes. If `true`, the request is validated but not executed. Only errors are returned, not results.

UserIdentifier.description: A single identifier for the user.

phoneNumber.description: Hashed phone number using SHA-256 hash function after normalization (E164 standard).

emailAddress.description: Hashed email address using SHA-256 hash function after normalization.

address.description: The known components of a user's address. Holds a grouping of identifiers that are matched all at once.

currencyCode.description: Optional. The currency in which cost and max_cost is specified. Must be a three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

costType.description: Immutable. The cost type of this pricing. Can be set only in the `create` operation. Can't be updated for an existing license.

buyerApprovalState.description: Output only. The buyer approval state of this pricing. This field is read-only.
enumDescriptions: User list client has not yet accepted the pricing terms set by the user list owner.
User list client has accepted the pricing terms set by the user list owner.
User list client has rejected the pricing terms set by the user list owner.

maxCostMicros.description: Optional. The maximum CPM a commerce audience can be charged when the MEDIA_SHARE cost type is used. The value is in micro units (10^-6) and in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`. This is only relevant when cost_type is MEDIA_SHARE. When cost_type is not MEDIA_SHARE, and this field is set, a MAX_COST_NOT_ALLOWED error will be returned. If not set or set to`0`, there is no cap.

pricingActive.description: Output only. Whether this pricing is active.

pricingId.description: Output only. The ID of this pricing.

startTime.description: Output only. Start time of the pricing.

costMicros.description: Optional. The cost associated with the model, in micro units (10^-6), in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`.

endTime.description: Optional. End time of the pricing.

mediaSkippable.description: Optional. Whether the ad media was skippable or not.

viewablePercent.description: Optional. The numerical percent (0-100) of the pixels that were viewable.

mediaVolumePercent.description: Optional. The numerical percent (0-100) of the volume of the media playback.

viewType.description: Required. The type of the event.

mediaQuartile.description: Optional. The amount of the media that was played as discrete quartiles.

playbackDuration.description: Optional. The duration of playback of the ad media, regardless of whether it was viewable or not.

mediaDuration.description: Optional. The duration of the ad media.

viewableDuration.description: Optional. The amount of time the ad was viewable for.

ViewabilityInfo.description: Details of the viewability of the ad served.

AudienceMember.description: The audience member to be operated on.

pairData.description: [Publisher Advertiser Identity Reconciliation (PAIR) IDs](//support.google.com/admanager/answer/15067908). This feature is only available to data partners.

userData.description: User-provided data that identifies the user.

destinationReferences.description: Optional. Defines which Destination to send the audience member to.

ppidData.description: Data related to publisher provided identifiers. This feature is only available to data partners.

consent.description: Optional. The consent setting for the user.

userIdData.description: Data related to unique identifiers for a user, as defined by the advertiser.

mobileData.description: Data identifying the user's mobile devices.

value.description: Required. The string representation of the value of the parameter to set.

parameterName.description: Required. The name of the parameter to use.

EventLocation.description: The location where the event occurred.

city.description: Optional. The name of the city where the event occurred.

regionCode.description: Optional. The 2-letter CLDR region code of the user's address.

subdivisionCode.description: Optional. The ISO 3166-2 subdivision code where the event occurred.

subcontinentCode.description: Optional. The subcontinent code in UN M49 format where the event occurred.

continentCode.description: Optional. The continent code in UN M49 format where the event occurred.

storeId.description: Optional. Required for Store Sales. The identifier to represent a physical store where the event happened.

lastUpdatedTimestamp.description: Optional. The last time the event was updated.

eventLocation.description: Optional. Information gathered about the location of the user when this event occurred.

userId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for a user, as defined by the advertiser.

conversionCount.description: Optional. The conversion quantity associated with the event, for counting-based conversions.

customVariables.description: Optional. Additional key/value pair information to send to the conversion containers (conversion action or FL activity).

enumDescriptions: Unspecified EventSource. Should never be used.
The event was generated from a web browser.
The event was generated from an app.
The event was generated from an in-store transaction.
The event was generated from a phone call.
The event was generated from a message.
The event was generated from other sources.
eventSource.description: Optional. Signal for where the event happened (web, app, in-store, etc.).

currency.description: Optional. The currency code associated with all monetary values within this event.

adIdentifiers.description: Optional. Identifiers and other information used to match the conversion event with other online activity (such as ad clicks).

additionalEventParameters.description: Optional. A bucket of any [event parameters](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/protocol/ga4/reference/events) to be included within the event that were not already specified using other structured fields.

eventName.description: Optional. The name of the event. Required for GA4 events.

eventTimestamp.description: Required. The time the event occurred.

appInstanceId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for the user instance of an app client for this GA4 app stream.

userData.description: Optional. Pieces of user provided data, representing the user the event is associated with.

userProperties.description: Optional. Advertiser-assessed information about the user at the time that the event happened.

thirdPartyUserData.description: Optional. The same type of data provided in user_data, but explicitly flagged as being provided as owned by a third-party and not first-party advertiser data.

clientId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for the user instance of a web client for this GA4 web stream.

transactionId.description: Optional. The unique identifier for this event. Required for events sent as an additional data source for tag conversions.

consent.description: Optional. Information about whether the associated user has provided different types of consent.

conversionValue.description: Optional. The conversion value associated with the event, for value-based conversions.

experimentalFields.description: Optional. A list of key/value pairs for experimental fields that may eventually be promoted to be part of the API.

eventDeviceInfo.description: Optional. Information gathered about the device being used (if any) when the event happened.

destinationReferences.description: Optional. Reference string used to determine the destination. If empty, the event will be sent to all destinations in the request.

cartData.description: Optional. Information about the transaction and items associated with the event.

Event.description: An event representing a user interaction with an advertiser's website or app.

parameterName.description: Required. The name of the parameter to use.

value.description: Required. The string representation of the value of the parameter to set.

ItemParameter.description: A bucket of any [event parameters related to an item](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/protocol/ga4/reference/events) to be included within the event that were not already specified using other structured fields.

warningCounts.description: A list of warnings and counts per warning reason.

WarningInfo.description: Warning counts for each type of warning.

additionalItemParameters.description: Optional. A bucket of any [event parameters related to an item](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/protocol/ga4/reference/events) to be included within the event that were not already specified using other structured fields.

customVariables.description: Optional. Additional key/value pair information to send to the conversion containers (conversion action or Floodlight activity), when tracking per-item conversions.

quantity.description: Optional. The number of this item associated with the event.

merchantProductId.description: Optional. The product ID within the Merchant Center account.

conversionValue.description: Optional. The conversion value associated with this item within the event, for cases where the conversion value is different for each item.

merchantFeedLabel.description: Optional. The feed label of the Merchant Center feed. If countries are still being used, the 2-letter country code in ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 can be used instead. For Store Sales events this will override the value set at the cart level. This field is ignored for other events.

merchantId.description: Optional. The Merchant Center ID associated with the item. For Store Sales events this will override the value set at the cart level. This field is ignored for other events.

unitPrice.description: Optional. The unit price excluding tax, shipping, and any transaction level discounts.

itemId.description: Optional. A unique identifier to reference the item.

merchantFeedLanguageCode.description: Optional. The language code in ISO 639-1 associated with the Merchant Center feed where your items are uploaded.

Item.description: Represents an item in the cart associated with the event.

membershipDuration.description: Optional. The duration a user remains in the user list. Valid durations are exact multiples of 24 hours (86400 seconds). Providing a value that is not an exact multiple of 24 hours will result in an INVALID_ARGUMENT error.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the user list. Format: accountTypes/{account_type}/accounts/{account}/userLists/{user_list}

ingestedUserListInfo.description: Optional. Represents a user list that is populated by user ingested data.

enumDescriptions: The resource is owned by the user.
The resource is shared to the user.
The resource is licensed to the user.
The user subscribed to the resource.
The resource is accessible to the user.
accessReason.description: Output only. The reason this account has been granted access to the list.

displayName.description: Required. The display name of the user list.

integrationCode.description: Optional. An ID from external system. It is used by user list sellers to correlate IDs on their systems.

readOnly.description: Output only. An option that indicates if a user may edit a list.

accountAccessStatus.description: Optional. Indicates if this share is still enabled. When a user list is shared with the account this field is set to `ENABLED`. Later the user list owner can decide to revoke the share and make it `DISABLED`.

closingReason.description: Output only. The reason why this user list membership status is closed.
enumDescriptions: The user list was closed because it has not been used in targeting recently. See https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2472738 for details.

membershipStatus.description: Optional. Membership status of this user list.
enumDescriptions: Open status - User list is accruing members and can be targeted to.
Closed status - No new members being added.

targetNetworkInfo.description: Optional. Eligibility information for different target networks.

description.description: Optional. A description of the user list.

id.description: Output only. The unique ID of the user list.

sizeInfo.description: Output only. Estimated number of members in this user list in different target networks.

PartnerAudienceInfo.description: Additional information for partner audiences. This feature is only available to data partners.

enumDescriptions: Partner Audience source is commerce audience.
Partner Audience source is linear TV audience.
Partner Audience source is agency/provider audience.
partnerAudienceSource.description: Required. Immutable. The source of the partner audience.

commercePartner.description: Optional. The commerce partner name. Only allowed if `partner_audience_source` is `COMMERCE_AUDIENCE`.

regionCodes.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region codes.

Location.description: The baseline location of the request. Baseline location is on OR-list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region codes of the requested regions.

keyId.description: Required. The ID of the chosen coordinator key.

baseline.description: Required. Baseline for the insights requested.

userListId.description: Required. The user list ID for which insights are requested.
